props.title: New Article: Files Won the AI Memory War. Almost Nobody Announced It.

props.text: Letta's filesystem agent (74.0% on LoCoMo) just outperformed Mem0's top graph variant (68.5%). Anthropic's memory tool ships as a directory, not a vector store. Obsidian quietly crossed 1.5M users on plain markdown — and Aeon's `memory/` directory turns out to be the same layout: index file, topic files, daily logs. The clever thing was building the database. The right thing was the folder.
